delivery_nature.statement: Batch B16 (10 test suites) decouples 4 test suites using existing production router seams without importing main.py (29/29 tests pass). The remaining 6 test suites test command admission, precondition enforcement, approval checks, two-man signature gates, and cross-domain command execution bridges whose implementations are private to services/control-plane/bff/main.py. Because PR #5757 rejected synthetic test-owned route doubles (P1 coverage loss) and modifying main.py or creating new production modules is forbidden under the B16 contract grant, those 6 suites are retained at clean origin/dev baseline and reported as a contract discrepancy requiring an upstream seam extraction task.

seam_analysis.architectural_blocker: Composition root main.py contains private functions implementing core command write admission, precondition validation, and canonical error generation that have not yet been extracted into modular production seams.

private_functions_in_main.role: Central command write admission coordinator enforcing preconditions, confirm-token redemption, approval checks, two-man signature gates, HumanGate normalization, and dual-write command receipts.
Enforces 428 CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, 409 APPROVAL_REQUIRED, and 409 TWO_MAN_REQUIRED preconditions.
Generates structured foundation_error, policy_decision, and audit_action error payloads for command admission rejections.
Projects CommandSubmissionResponse from command store receipts and execution results.

seam_analysis.governed_precedent: Follows precedent established by B03, B05 (BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B05-JOURNAL-CONTEXT-RESOLVER-SEAM-DECISION-001), B06, and B14. When production seams are unextracted, workers must not modify main.py (outside grant) nor create synthetic test-owned routes (P1 coverage loss). Workers must record an anchor commit with exact missing-seam evidence and request governed contract revision / prerequisite seam extraction.

recommended_upstream_task.objective: Extract _submit_final_command_admission, _require_final_command_preconditions, _foundation_bff_error, and command write routers from main.py into an exportable, injectable router/service module, enabling downstream test suites to mount production routes without importing main.py.
